EX-99.3 9 ex993_3.htm EXHIBIT 99.3 Exhibit 99.3 Vivani Medical Announces Positive Top-Line Results from SLIM-1™, a First in Human Phase 1 Trial of NPM-139 (semaglutide implant) and Wegovy (weekly semaglutide injections) in Obese and Overweight Subjects Strong NPM-139 safety and tolerability profile: -0 of 10 NPM-139 subjects experienced adverse events reported as treatment related -5 of 10 Wegovy subjects (control group) experienced adverse events reported as treatment related (gastrointestinal only, consistent with marketed GLP-1 therapies) Encouraging NPM-139 semaglutide release profile: -No NPM-139 rapid drug exposure increases; maximum drug levels from a single administration measured at ~16 days (versus ~2.4 days for the Wegovy control group) -NPM-139 semaglutide delivery was encouraging and consistent with preclinical performance -Comparable weight loss was observed between the NPM-139 and Wegovy groups Clinical advancement supported: -Vivani will advance NPM-139 towards a Phase 2 dose-ranging weight maintenance trial anticipated to begin in 2027 -Vivani will explore the potential for clinical development of NPM-139 in GLP-1-naïve patients based on the positive SLIM-1 tolerability profile ALAMEDA, Calif., November 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Vivani Medical, Inc.

(Nasdaq: VANI) (“Vivani” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing miniature, ultra-long-acting drug implants utilizing its proprietary NanoPortal™ technology, today reported positive top-line results from SLIM-1, the Company’s recently completed Phase 1 trial of low-dose NPM-139 (semaglutide implant) and a control group of low-dose Wegovy™ (semaglutide injection).

“The positive top-line data from our SLIM-1 Phase 1 trial marks a critical milestone for Vivani, demonstrating encouraging clinical translation from preclinical models to humans, an encouraging delivery profile, and a strong tolerability profile,” said Adam Mendelsohn, CEO of Vivani Medical.

We expect that quick reversibility will be a compelling feature for certain segments of the GLP-1 market who would like an ultra-long-acting option but would need one that offers quick reversibility, including the approximately 23% of GLP-1 users who are women of child-bearing age due to recommendations against continued GLP-1 use during pregnancy.” Vivani Chairman of the Board, Gregg Williams, stated, “I’m very excited about the new top-line SLIM-1 data released today and continue to believe these miniature, ultra-long-acting drug implants have the potential to revolutionize the treatment of chronic diseases including obesity and type 2 diabetes.
